## Contributors And Credits

- [Hanifa Septhi Larasati](https://github.com/hanifasepthi) - Developer utama, publisher Hanifa Teams, dan pemilik repository ITS Maps.
- [Roboflow RF-DETR](https://github.com/roboflow/rf-detr) - Rujukan arsitektur object detection RF-DETR untuk pipeline deteksi visual.
- [Hugging Face onnx-community](https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/rfdetr_nano-ONNX) - Model ONNX yang dipakai oleh runtime browser object detection.
- [Transformers.js / Xenova](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js) - Runtime inference JavaScript untuk model AI di browser.
